scenes.label: Meet Rohan
scenes.title: Sunday at Nani’s house
scenes.caption: Meet Rohan. Every Sunday, he visits his Nani. Today they're playing carrom, and Nani is winning again! Then her phone buzzes. A message pops up with a secret code. A moment later, the phone starts ringing.

scenes.label: The call
scenes.title: “Just read me the code.”
scenes.caption: A friendly voice says, “Hello, Nani! Your parcel is waiting. Just read me the code that came on your phone.” Nani reaches for her glasses to read it out. Rohan's tummy feels funny. Something isn't right.

scenes.label: Rohan remembers
scenes.title: Secret codes stay secret.
scenes.caption: Rohan remembers what his teacher said. Codes that come on a phone are like keys. Secret codes stay secret! A real parcel company, bank or office will never ask you for one. Look, even the message says: don't share this code.
scenes.dialogue: Nani, wait! Don’t read it out!

scenes.label: Your turn
scenes.title: Block the call. Tell Mum.
scenes.caption: Now it's your turn. The caller is still waiting. Help Rohan keep Nani's code safe. Tap the big shield to end the call. Then tell Mum what happened. This is a pretend call, just for practice.
scenes.dialogue: Help me keep Nani’s code safe!

scenes.label: Mum explains
scenes.title: OTPs and PINs stay private.
scenes.caption: Mum hugs them both. “That code is called an OTP, a one-time password. A PIN is a secret number too. Never share them, even with a kind voice. If a call feels wrong, hang up. A grown-up can call the number on the card.”
scenes.speech: Mum hugs them both. “That code is called an O T P, a one-time password. A pin is a secret number too. Never share them, even with a kind voice. If a call feels wrong, hang up. A grown-up can call the number on the card.”

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Nani’s code stayed secret.
scenes.caption: Mum helps Nani check her bank app. Everything is safe, because the code stayed secret. Nani laughs and wins at carrom again! Remember: secret codes stay secret. Your turn: help Rohan guard Nani's code on a pretend call!
